Subject: Mid-year calibration: variance resolution and distribution adjustments

Morning team — attaching the draft calibration matrix and two anonymized examples that surfaced higher-than-expected spread between managers.

Key asks:
- Please review highlighted outliers (tab: "Outliers") and flag any that are clear case-misratings by EOD Thursday.
- For teams with >1.5x variance from peer cohort, suggest either manager recalibration or a documented exception with evidence.
- Marissa: can you confirm comp/bonus downstream constraints if we move distributions?

Rationale: We need to reduce manager-to-manager variance before comp cycle. The attached matrix shows current distribution vs. proposed normalized distribution by function. I propose applying a mild smoothing (one-step bump toward cohort mean) for small teams, and targeted review for outliers.

Attachments: calibration_matrix_q2_2026.xlsx, anonymized_rating_examples.pdf

Thanks — Jonas

Thanks for the matrix — I looked through the proposed normalization. A few compliance and comp-operational notes: 

- Any changes that shift someone across a comp band midpoint will trigger a comp review and potentially off-cycle adjustments; that has payroll lead time (~3 weeks) and budget approvals.
- For exceptions (e.g., Realtime senior IC), we need a one-paragraph evidence summary saved to the calibration doc and HR ticket created (I can create templates).
- We should avoid retrospective retro-pay wherever possible; prefer title/bonus eligibility notes at midyear.

Suggested process:
1) Managers submit evidence forms for all outliers by Thursday EOD.
2) Calibration sync Friday 9am PT to decide exceptions and smoothing steps.
3) People Ops runs impact model Monday and flags any required comp approvals.

I also recommend we loop in an external calibration auditor (Sara Ahmed at TalentWorks) for a quick 2-hour review to validate we aren't creating inadvertent demographic skew. I copied her below and can set up time if you want.

Subject: Calibration decisions and next steps (summary)

Thanks all for the quick turn. Summary and actions from today's review: 

Decisions made:
- Adopted the one-step smoothing for pods <5 headcount where no substantive evidence is provided.
- Kept three documented exceptions (Realtime senior IC; infra lead on critical rollout; one org-change case). Exceptions documented in the "Exceptions" tab with manager write-ups.
- For teams with manager variance >1.5x driven by insufficient evidence, managers will be asked to either provide evidence or accept the smoothed rating.

Action items (owners + due dates):
- Managers: submit evidence forms for flagged outliers by Thu 6/24 EOD (owner: respective manager; template in Drive).
- People Ops (Marissa): run comp impact model Monday 6/22 and escalate any off-cycle approvals needed to Finance (ticket created: HR-4571).
- L&D/Manager Enablement (Grace): schedule two calibration training sessions next week focused on evidence write-ups and rating guidelines.
- Jonas/Laura: finalize the calibration doc and publish a short FAQ to the company noting that ratings were calibrated but exceptions were preserved (target publish: 6/26).

Compliance note: Sara Ahmed from TalentWorks will do a light audit Wed 6/24 — she has access to anonymized data only. If anyone has privacy concerns, flag to Marissa.

Attachments: calibration_matrix_q2_2026.xlsx (finalized), anonymized_rating_examples.pdf

Thanks — Jonas
